```{pyodide}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "monospace",
    "font.size": 13,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fafafa",
    "figure.dpi": 120,
    "savefig.dpi": 120,
})

COLORS = {
    "match": "#4CAF50",
    "mismatch": "#F44336",
    "current": "#FFC107",
    "skip": "#90CAF9",
    "default": "#E0E0E0",
    "pattern": "#BBDEFB",
    "border": "#7E57C2",
}


def draw_string_row(ax, y, string, label="", highlights=None, offset=0):
    """Draw a row of character boxes at vertical position y."""
    highlights = highlights or {}
    for i, ch in enumerate(string):
        color = highlights.get(i, COLORS["default"])
        rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (i + offset, y), 0.9, 0.9,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
            facecolor=color, edgecolor="#555", linewidth=1.2,
        )
        ax.add_patch(rect)
        ax.text(i + offset + 0.45, y + 0.45, ch,
                ha="center", va="center", fontsize=14, fontweight="bold")
    if label:
        ax.text(offset - 0.3, y + 0.45, label,
                ha="right", va="center", fontsize=12, color="#555")
```

## Z-Algorithm

Visualize the Z-array: `Z[k]` = length of the longest substring starting at `k` that matches a prefix of `S`.

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
#| output: false

def compute_z(S):
    """Compute Z-array for string S."""
    n = len(S)
    Z = [0] * n
    Z[0] = n
    l, r = 0, 0
    for k in range(1, n):
        if k < r:
            Z[k] = min(r - k, Z[k - l])
        while k + Z[k] < n and S[Z[k]] == S[k + Z[k]]:
            Z[k] += 1
        if k + Z[k] > r:
            l, r = k, k + Z[k]
    return Z


def z_trace(S):
    """Step-by-step Z computation returning full state at each k."""
    n = len(S)
    Z = [0] * n
    Z[0] = n
    snapshots = []
    l, r = 0, 0
    for k in range(1, n):
        init_from_zbox = False
        init_val = 0
        if k < r:
            init_val = min(r - k, Z[k - l])
            Z[k] = init_val
            init_from_zbox = True

        explicit_comps = 0
        while k + Z[k] < n and S[Z[k]] == S[k + Z[k]]:
            Z[k] += 1
            explicit_comps += 1

        old_l, old_r = l, r
        if k + Z[k] > r:
            l, r = k, k + Z[k]

        snapshots.append({
            "k": k, "Z": list(Z), "l": l, "r": r,
            "old_l": old_l, "old_r": old_r,
            "init_from_zbox": init_from_zbox,
            "init_val": init_val,
            "explicit_comps": explicit_comps,
            "zbox_updated": (l != old_l or r != old_r),
        })
    return snapshots


def draw_z_step(S, step_idx):
    snapshots = z_trace(S)
    if not snapshots:
        return
    step_idx = min(step_idx, len(snapshots) - 1)
    snap = snapshots[step_idx]
    n = len(S)
    k = snap["k"]
    Z = snap["Z"]
    l, r = snap["l"], snap["r"]
    zk = Z[k]

    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(max(n * 0.8, 10), 7.5))
    gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 1, height_ratios=[4, 2.5, 2], hspace=0.35)

    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
    ax.set_xlim(-2.0, n + 1.0)
    ax.set_ylim(-2.5, 4.0)
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.axis("off")

    for i in range(n):
        ax.text(i + 0.45, 3.3, str(i), ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#999")

    s_hi = {}
    if zk > 0:
        for j in range(zk):
            s_hi[j] = COLORS["match"]
            s_hi[k + j] = COLORS["skip"]
        s_hi[k] = COLORS["current"]
    else:
        s_hi[k] = COLORS["current"]
    draw_string_row(ax, 2.0, S, label="S", highlights=s_hi)

    ax.annotate(f"k={k}", xy=(k + 0.45, 2.0), xytext=(k + 0.45, 1.4),
                fontsize=10, ha="center", color="#C62828", fontweight="bold",
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#C62828", lw=1.5))

    if r > 0:
        box_y = 3.6
        ax.plot([l, r - 0.1], [box_y, box_y], color=COLORS["border"], lw=3, solid_capstyle="round")
        ax.plot([l, l], [box_y - 0.15, box_y + 0.15], color=COLORS["border"], lw=2)
        ax.plot([r - 0.1, r - 0.1], [box_y - 0.15, box_y + 0.15], color=COLORS["border"], lw=2)
        ax.text((l + r) / 2, box_y + 0.3, f"Z-box [l={l}, r={r})",
                ha="center", fontsize=9, color=COLORS["border"], fontweight="bold")

    if zk > 0:
        ax.annotate("", xy=(k, -0.3), xytext=(k + zk - 0.1, -0.3),
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color="#1565C0", lw=2))
        ax.text(k + zk / 2, -0.7, f"Z[{k}]={zk}", ha="center",
                fontsize=11, color="#1565C0", fontweight="bold")
        ax.annotate("", xy=(0, -0.3), xytext=(zk - 0.1, -0.3),
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color=COLORS["match"], lw=1.5))
        ax.text(zk / 2, -0.7, f"prefix[0..{zk-1}]", ha="center",
                fontsize=9, color=COLORS["match"])

    parts = []
    if snap["init_from_zbox"]:
        parts.append(f"Z-box reuse: Z[{k}-{l}]=Z[{k-l}]={Z[k-l]}, "
                     f"min({snap['old_r']}-{k}, Z[{k-l}])={snap['init_val']}")
    if snap["explicit_comps"] > 0:
        parts.append(f"explicit comparisons: {snap['explicit_comps']}")
    if snap["zbox_updated"]:
        parts.append(f"Z-box updated: [{snap['old_l']},{snap['old_r']}) -> [{l},{r})")
    info = " | ".join(parts) if parts else f"Z[{k}]=0, no prefix match"

    ax.set_title(f"Z-Algorithm step {step_idx+1}/{len(snapshots)} | k={k} | Z[{k}]={zk}\n{info}",
                 fontsize=10, pad=8)

    ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
    ax2.set_xlim(-2.0, n + 0.5)
    ax2.set_ylim(-0.3, 2.2)
    ax2.set_aspect("equal")
    ax2.axis("off")
    ax2.set_title("Z-array (computed so far)", fontsize=10, pad=3, loc="left")

    for i in range(n):
        computed = i == 0 or i <= k
        if i == k:
            color = COLORS["current"]
        elif computed and Z[i] > 0:
            color = "#E8F5E9"
        elif computed:
            color = "#FAFAFA"
        else:
            color = "#F0F0F0"
        rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (i, 0.3), 0.9, 0.9, boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
            facecolor=color, edgecolor="#555" if computed else "#CCC",
            linewidth=1.0 if computed else 0.5)
        ax2.add_patch(rect)
        val = str(Z[i]) if computed else "?"
        ax2.text(i + 0.45, 0.75, val, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11,
                 fontweight="bold" if computed else "normal",
                 color="#333" if computed else "#BBB")
        ax2.text(i + 0.45, 0.05, str(i), ha="center", fontsize=7, color="#999")
        ax2.text(i + 0.45, 1.55, S[i], ha="center", fontsize=10, fontfamily="monospace", color="#555")
    ax2.text(-0.3, 0.75, "Z", ha="right", va="center", fontsize=11, color="#555")
    ax2.text(-0.3, 1.55, "S", ha="right", va="center", fontsize=11, color="#555")

    ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
    positions = list(range(n))
    values = [Z[i] if i <= k else 0 for i in range(n)]
    colors_bar = [COLORS["current"] if i == k else (COLORS["skip"] if i <= k and Z[i] > 0 else "#E0E0E0") for i in range(n)]
    ax3.bar(positions, values, color=colors_bar, edgecolor="#777", width=0.7)
    ax3.set_ylabel("Z[k]", fontsize=9)
    ax3.set_xticks(positions)
    ax3.set_xticklabels([str(i) for i in positions], fontsize=7)
    ax3.set_title("Z-values bar chart", fontsize=9, loc="left")

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```
